title: From nothing to evidence
summary: Six steps that end with a defensible record of a network you are allowed to assess. Each one names something to look at, not just something to click.

steps.title: Know which radio you are holding
steps.goal: Confirm the attached board by its USB serial and VID/PID before anything else.
steps.why: A port name is not an identity. Boards move between ports, and a survey attributed to the wrong device is worse than no survey — you cannot tell later which one produced it.
steps.look_for: The device row shows a stable serial, not just a /dev path.

steps.title: Listen before you touch anything
steps.goal: Run a passive sweep and watch access points appear.
steps.why: Everything downstream is an argument about what is there. Passive observation is the only step that cannot change what you are measuring.
steps.look_for: Channel changes and dwell times in the dry run, then real BSSIDs in Observe.

steps.title: Read what the advertisement actually says
steps.goal: Open a Bluetooth device and read its raw manufacturer payload, not only the vendor guess.
steps.why: A vendor name is inferred from three bytes. The payload is the evidence. Learning to distrust the inference is most of what separates a survey from a screenshot.
steps.look_for: The byte string under the vendor column, and whether the guess is even plausible.

steps.title: Write down what you are allowed to touch
steps.goal: Set the allow-list to the BSSIDs you actually have permission to assess.
steps.why: Scope decided in advance is a control. Scope decided while looking at a target is a rationalisation. The firmware enforces whichever one you wrote down.
steps.look_for: A session grant reporting the scope, rate and duration actually in force.

steps.title: Ask whether it recovers
steps.goal: Dry-run a recovery test, read every step, and only then decide whether to run it.
steps.why: The dry run tells you how many frames it would emit before a single one goes out. If that number surprises you, you were not ready to run it.
steps.look_for: The frame total, and the tx capability declared on the card before you opened it.

steps.title: Leave with something you can hand over
steps.goal: Export a posture report, pseudonymised, and read it as the recipient would.
steps.why: The artifact outlives the session. Pseudonymised means you can share the finding without sharing the estate, and the report says on its face that its identifiers are not real.
steps.look_for: The banner explaining the identifiers are pseudonyms, and that the findings are unchanged.
